primary_definition: Verified physical and visual grasp, sustained bilateral contact >=80%, >=1 nominal mL transfer, correct full/empty stop, return/release/retreat, no gates, >=90% rim height or source<=max(.25mL,1% initial), zero final outside and ever-near-worktop particles.
caveat: 20Hz simulator measurements, not calibrated physical volume or continuously splash-free performance. No-pour attempts cannot pass.

development_selection.known_full_stop_limitations: Evaluate V22 after eight verified grasps and returns with zero measured loss; retain the two full-stop confirmation failures and unchanged strict scores. Thirty unused tests run once without further tuning.
development_selection.scope: Explicit benchmark selection may retain documented full-stop failures. All eight must still grasp, transfer, return and have zero measured loss. No outcome is relabeled; reserved scoring is unchanged.

selection.primary_definition: Verified grasp and transfer; correct full/empty stop; >=90% settled rim height or empty source; ordered return/release; zero measured final/near-table particle loss.
selection.volume_units: Nominal particle-count mL, not calibrated physical volume
selection.test_policy: Thirty reserved once-only scenes. No retries, fitting, threshold/source changes or teacher fallback during evaluation.
